notes: Transitions are kept consistent and intentionally sparse. More effects do not automatically make a more professional edit.
Only transition IDs known to the local capcut-cli profile are used by default. Verify presets in the installed CapCut build.
Per-project settings can override target_shot_seconds, minimum_shot_seconds, scene_zoom_start/end, scene_pan_amount and presenter_pose_seconds.

whiteboard_smooth.label: Whiteboard Explainer — Smooth
whiteboard_smooth.description: Calm paper canvas, readable framed scene cards, persistent presenter, subtle drift.

horror_comedy.label: Horror Comedy — Controlled Punch
horror_comedy.description: Mostly clean cuts and dissolves; occasional motion blur for a reveal; keep sound effects selective.

documentary_cinematic.label: Documentary — Gentle Cinematic
documentary_cinematic.description: Longer holds, low amplitude movement, quiet dissolves and rare chapter accents.

energetic_explainer.label: Energetic Explainer — Snappy
energetic_explainer.description: Shorter beats, larger but still restrained movement, dynamic section transitions.

nutty_putty_casefile.label: Nutty Putty Cave — Full-frame Illustrated Horror
nutty_putty_casefile.description: Pure-white canvas, fast slide-in/slide-out artwork, rotating left/center/right compositions, occasional paired-image inserts, continuous zoom pulses, selective snap-shake beats, and restrained scale-pop replacements.
